description: Agent Vendors: submit the delivery promise for one vendor engagement and where else it is stated: the promise as written, read for hedges such as usually, as soon as possible or estimated, its timeframe, the date it is delivered by, what the timeframe counts from, the delivery method, what counts as delivered and the proof of delivery the buyer receives; and each other statement of the same promise with its id, its source (the quote, the terms, a listing, the order, an invoice, correspondence or other), its timeframe, delivery date, method and text. The signed report gives the promise read in days (business days at five to the week, a range at its upper end) with any hedges, every other statement with its days, date and method and its status as agrees, contradicts or unread, each part with its status, and counts the statements agreeing, contradicting and unread, and names a delivery promise contradicted where it is stated elsewhere: another number of days, another date or another method; then no timeframe, a timeframe with no number or date, a hedged timeframe, no starting point, no method, nothing saying what counts as delivered and no proof of delivery, with the fix for each. This reads the whole delivery promise before the spend: a shipping promise against its delivery evidence after the fact is wever_shipping-check, delivered work against its acceptance criteria is wever_deliverable-check and an uptime commitment after an outage is wever_sla-credit-check. Verdict delivery_contradicted, delivery_partial, delivery_unstated or delivery_terms_clear. POST /api/vendor-delivery-check. Reads only the recorded vendor material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no vendor is contacted, no quote is accepted, no order is placed and no spend is approved. Agent Vendors reads the seller on the other side of a spend before the agent commits: whether the vendor is who it claims to be, whether its quote and terms hold together, whether its price stays the same and what it costs to leave. It is not one service’s terms on their own (wever_service-terms-check reads one service’s terms by themselves; the vendor terms-match check reads a vendor’s terms against the specific quote or order in front of the agent, where a contradiction costs money), not pricing structure or fee evidence (wever_pricing-tier-check and wever_fee-evidence-check; the vendor price check reads whether the price this vendor quoted this buyer stays consistent across the quote, the listing and any invoice or prior charge), not single promise types (wever_warranty-check and wever_shipping-check; the vendor delivery and refund checks read the whole delivery promise and the whole remedy path for one vendor engagement), not listing accuracy (wever_catalog-listing-check reads whether a catalog listing is accurate; a directory or marketplace listing being present is not vendor verification, and no vendor check treats listing presence as identity evidence), not after the payment (wever_purchase-record-check and wever_double-charge-check run after a payment; the vendor checks run before the spend, while walking away is still free), not the buyer’s own permission (wever_spending-policy-check and wever_authority-scope-check read the buyer’s permission to spend; the vendor checks read the seller on the other side of the spend: permission is not diligence, and diligence is not permission), not a promise once made (the wever_commitment checks; a vendor engagement becomes a commitment only after the agent accepts it, and the vendor checks guard the moment before that) and not an objective (the wever_goal checks read the objective the work serves; a vendor check reads a counterparty, not an objective). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-vendors-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-vendors/.
